payload.reason: The evidence provides specific criteria for selecting the top 10 nonsynonymous mutations based on frequency and biological impact.

claims.text: The top 10 nonsynonymous mutations were selected based on their frequency in primary lineages associated with variants of concern (VOCs).
The selection also considered the biological impact of mutations, as some may have little or no effect on viral transmission and pathogenesis.
The concurrence ratio of co-mutations among the top 10 nonsynonymous mutations was analyzed to understand their functional interactions.
